Changelog:
v1.0.4.17 - CRITICAL: Pyretic / Acceleration Bomb safety. The v1.0.4.13 AutoDuty-yield only blocked autorotation; the plugin was still firing actions through combo replacement during Pyretic and killing the player (Joey verified on the first boss of the latest dungeon). New NoActStatus helper detects Pyretic (status 960) and Acceleration Bomb (1387/2127), and is now gated at both ShouldSkipAutorotation AND the top of UseActionDetour so every UseAction call is hard-swallowed while the status is active, regardless of whether AutoDuty, the user, or the plugin queued it.

Also: Hold-to-Repeat has been removed entirely from GluttonyCombo. It is being moved to a standalone plugin (LazyPress, shipping separately) so it does not ride along with the combo plugin.
